classification: Known implementation gaps retained from source matrix and remaining-gaps.md; not current Adobe comparison results

families.implementation: Compact menus, options, tools, tabs and panels are present. Exact Windows CS6 screenshot equivalence has not been established; LopeOS supplies outer window chrome.
Panel groups can be rearranged, floated, hidden and collapsed. Photoshop docking targets and document arrangements are incomplete.
Rulers and editable guides are available; full units, grids, snapping preferences and ruler measurement are incomplete.
Fixed commands and tool shortcuts are available; user remapping is unavailable.
There is one active canvas; tiled, floating and synchronized views are unavailable.
The status strip reports image dimensions and zoom; dedicated Info/Navigator panels are absent.
Common brush controls and a fixed swatch palette are present; preset import/export and management are absent.
RGB/8 supported descriptors round trip. Smart Objects, vectors, effects, alpha channels and specialist data have documented conversion limits.
Browser raster decoders handle supported files; animation timelines are not imported.

families.feature: TIFF, PSB, PDF and EPS workflows
families.implementation: These professional interchange pipelines are unavailable in this editor.
Direct camera/scanner acquisition and Adobe Bridge integration are absent.
Resolution and profile/depth metadata are retained where supported; full IPTC/EXIF management is absent.
Serialization runs in a worker; the current operation guard still disables editing during save.
Visibility and a whole-layer lock are supported. Separate pixel, position, transparency and lock-all modes are absent.
Editable vector masks separate from shape content are unavailable.

Twenty-six deterministic RGB/8 layer and brush blend modes have scalar, Canvas fallback and WebGL implementations, with native/PSD name round trips. Dissolve is absent. Photoshop-specific Fill behavior for special blend modes is not reproduced; browser alpha round trips can differ by several channel levels.
Basic compositing is implemented; complex clipping, effects and knockout behavior need further work.
Editable stroke, drop shadow and color overlay exist. Glow, bevel, satin, pattern and gradient effect families are absent.
Embedded pixels/source files survive transforms and reset. Linked objects and nested source-document editing are absent.

Editable filter stacks preserve source pixels. Each selected filter captures independent soft coverage, follows later object transforms, persists in native files and uses incremental worker transport. Independent filter-mask painting, per-filter blending and Photoshop Smart Filter descriptors remain incomplete.
Layer-comp variants and persistent multi-layer linking are unavailable.
Automatic registration, panoramas and focus/exposure stack fusion are unavailable.
Edge-following magnetic selection is unavailable.
The Photoshop edge-guided selection brush is unavailable.
Sampled RGB color and fuzziness create soft global coverage; Photoshop color-space presets and localized clusters are absent.
Box-based feather and separable morphology are implemented; exact Photoshop kernels are not claimed.
Morphological border and thresholded smoothing are functional; Photoshop-specific refinement differs.
RGB channel previews exist; independent channel painting, Apply Image and Calculations are absent.
Hair-edge refinement, edge decontamination and its dedicated workspace are unavailable.
Layer transforms work; a separate selection-only transform operation is absent.
Non-destructive crop geometry and straightening exist; full CS6 crop presets, overlays and handle interaction are incomplete.
Interactive move, scale, rotate and flips plus numeric controls work, including groups and affine shear preservation. Perspective/distort handles are absent.
Four-corner projective crop is unavailable.
Deformation meshes and articulated warp pins are unavailable.
Seam carving and protected-content scaling are unavailable.
Liquify meshes and perspective-plane painting are unavailable.
Automatic panorama alignment and stitching are unavailable.
The supported document blend modes are exposed for brush painting; the complete CS6 painting-mode set is absent.
Basic circular brushes and pressure work; custom tips, scattering, texture, tilt and extensive dynamics/preset formats are absent.
Color-targeted and tolerance eraser tools are unavailable.
Sample correction with local color matching is implemented; Photoshop texture/lighting behavior is not reproduced exactly.

families.feature: Spot Healing, Patch and Content-Aware Move
families.implementation: Automatic content synthesis and patch relocation tools are unavailable.
CS6-style texture synthesis is unavailable; model-generated content is a separate newer workflow.
Local pixel kernels respect alpha, selection and opacity; Photoshop brush kernels differ.
A sampled-color reservoir produces real smearing; Photoshop pickup/finger-painting behavior is incomplete.
Tonal-range exposure and saturation painting are real and reversible; Adobe protect-tones behavior is not matched.
Foreground-to-background linear gradients work; multi-stop, radial, angle, reflected, diamond and preset editing are absent.

families.feature: Pattern Stamp, Mixer Brush and Art History Brush
families.implementation: These painting engines are unavailable.
Native-coordinate composite point sampling works; averaging, sampler points and Info readings are incomplete.
Editable RGB layers exist; curves currently use three points and Photoshop channel/auto/preset behavior is incomplete.
Editable local RGB algorithms exist; tonal ranges and Adobe color math differ.
Editable exposure/gamma and adaptive saturation controls exist with independent algorithms.
Color-band monochrome conversion and tint-density controls exist; Photoshop tint/luminosity behavior is incomplete.
A 3×4 RGB mixing matrix and two-endpoint gradient map are editable; monochrome mixing and arbitrary gradient stops are absent.
LUT import and CMYK-relative selective color adjustments are unavailable.
Dedicated local tone mapping and HDR pipelines are unavailable.

families.feature: Auto Tone, Auto Contrast and Auto Color
families.implementation: Automatic tonal analysis commands are unavailable.

families.feature: Match Color, Replace Color and Equalize
families.implementation: Dedicated matching and histogram equalization commands are unavailable.
This editor has no Camera Raw processing workspace; other LopeOS applications are separate capabilities.
Premultiplied-alpha blur operations and previews work; Gaussian is approximated with box passes, motion uses bounded samples.

families.feature: Sharpen, Unsharp Mask and High Pass
families.implementation: Real kernels and radius/amount/threshold controls exist; Adobe kernels are not reproduced exactly.
Deterministic monochromatic or color uniform noise exists; Gaussian distribution is absent.
Independent pixel kernels exist; the complete CS6 options and exact rendering differ.

families.feature: Field, Iris and Tilt-Shift Blur Gallery
families.implementation: CS6 on-canvas blur controls, masks and bokeh simulation are unavailable.

families.feature: Adaptive Wide Angle and Lens Correction
families.implementation: Lens-profile and perspective constraint engines are unavailable.
These dedicated filter engines are unavailable.
The artistic, brush stroke, sketch and texture filter galleries are unavailable.
Lens/Surface/Radial Blur, Reduce Noise, Median, Displace, Wave, Clouds and other unlisted families are absent.
One style per layer supports font, size, bold, italic, alignment, leading and tracking; mixed runs and paragraph boxes are incomplete.

families.feature: Vertical type, type on path and warp text
families.implementation: These type layouts are unavailable.
Browser font shaping is used; character/paragraph style libraries and CS6 typography controls are absent.
Editable primitive shapes and fill/stroke exist; the full CS6 shape library and dash/boolean controls are absent.
Polygonal paths, editable anchors and path-to-selection exist. Bézier handles and curve operations are absent.
Path boolean operations, curve conversion, stroke/fill-path options and text outlines are unavailable.
Profile bytes/labels may be retained; calibrated conversion, proof views and gamut warnings are absent.

families.feature: CMYK, Lab, Bitmap, Indexed and Duotone modes
families.implementation: These editing/conversion pipelines are unavailable.
High-depth processing and HDR merge/toning are unavailable; unsupported imports are explicitly rejected.
Printing, spot inks, press separations and proof workflows are unavailable.
These automated output layouts are unavailable.
Recordable command sequences, droplets and batch processing are unavailable.
Photoshop-compatible scripts, variables and dataset substitution are unavailable.
The CS6 video/timeline and animation workspace is unavailable.

families.feature: Slices and Save for Web optimization
families.implementation: Slice layouts, HTML output and indexed palette optimization are unavailable.
A Photoshop-compatible native/plugin scripting runtime is unavailable.
